CHAPTER 03 ✳

Awards & Honors

Recognition in science, engineering, and sport, alongside the lessons and teammates behind each achievement.

✳
2026 / STEM Innovation Fair

Grand Prize

Development of a solar-integrated sand battery thermal energy storage system

My friends and I worked through the scientific principles, assembly, and presentation of our prototype together. Receiving the prize made the long days of building and refining the project especially memorable.

Explore the Sand Battery project↗

Science & academics

2025Physics

Gold Medal · STEMCO

Summer Physics 11-12 competition, September 2025.

2026Science & Technology

Bronze Medal · Owlypia

Recognized in the Science and Technology OWLYS category after a period of focused research and product design.

2023-2024Physics

Third Prize · Hà Đông District Physics Competition

The competition showed me the cost of rushing through a problem. Looking back, those mistakes became valuable lessons as I prepared for a specialized high school. The certificate was issued on 3 November 2023 for the 2023-2024 school year.

2025Physics

29th place · Physics Brawl Online, Category B

Team Cool Matcha placed 29th in Category B in the 2025 international online competition. The demanding stretch of collaborative problem-solving made the result especially rewarding.

2024Physics

32nd place · Physics Brawl Online, Category C

Team Cool Matcha placed 32nd in Category C in the 2024 competition. Working through unfamiliar problems together helped us develop as a team.

Sport & perseverance

2026Football

Gold Medal · HSGS Cup

Winning the school-wide championship in Grade 11 was one of my most emotional sporting experiences. We trained hard, learned to trust our coach’s tactics, and built the chemistry we needed for difficult knockout matches and penalty shootouts.

2026Football

Silver Medal · Specialized Physics Football Tournament

2025Football

Bronze Medal · HSGS Physics 40th Anniversary Cup

The tournament brought together current students and alumni from the Specialized Physics program. Competing across generations made the event memorable, and our team finished with a victory in the third-place playoff.
